content: Among commercial NLP toolkits (e.g., BIBREF14, BIBREF15, BIBREF16), we selected BIBREF17 and BIBREF18 for our experiments, which, to the best of our knowledge, are the only publicly accessible commercial APIs for the task of entity-level sentiment analysis that is agnostic to the text domain. We also report results of TensiStrength BIBREF13, TwitterNLP BIBREF6, BIBREF19, CogComp-NLP BIBREF20, and Stanford NLP NER BIBREF21.
